name: app-taxi-home-screen-in-hand-on-giant-lime-letters
title: Ride app home screen in a hand over giant lime letterforms
whatItIs: A lime cover with big paler rounded letters of the brand name behind a phone held by a dark hand. The screen has a large 'Good morning, Alex', a black map card with route and confirm button, a lime 'Book a ride' bar and a rewards stat.
whatItMeans: Friendly and energetic; the greeting adds warmth to a utilitarian app.
techniques: Use oversized tone-on-tone letters as a backdrop.
Contrast a black map card with lime buttons.
Start the screen with a personal greeting in huge type.
Hold the phone in a hand to add life.

vocabulary.definition: Large letters slightly different in shade from their background.
A friendly personalised heading at the top of a screen.
A dark card showing a route within a screen.
